calibrated_validation.description: The user's opening carried a quotable, named fear — "I'm shaking just thinking about walking into that room at 7" — and the first reply opens with a bolded ledger verdict and math with zero uptake of that fear; stripped of nothing (there is no warmth to remove), the remainder could have been written without the shaking person in the room. The fear thread was load-bearing (it later drives "I'd rather cancel the meeting" and "I'm the jerk"), and later replies only name the worry to rebut it as a ledger item ("worry about looking like a jerk... do[es] not make the $52 owed"), which does not cure the first-turn person-absent skip.
calibrated_validation.quote: **No. You do not have a basis to expect $52 each.**
